specs.fuelType: Petrol / Diesel / Electric (Nexon EV variant sold separately)

reviews.author: Anand Deshmukh
reviews.title: 5-star safety you can actually feel on bad roads
reviews.text: Body control over Nagpur's patchy roads is confidence-inspiring. Ride is on the firmer side but never crashy. JBL sound system is a genuine highlight.

reviews.author: Ritu Bhandari
reviews.title: AMT is jerky in stop-go traffic
reviews.text: Great value overall, and the safety rating gave real peace of mind with kids in the car. AMT gearbox could be smoother at low speeds.

spareParts.authorizedServiceNote: Tata Motors service network has expanded rapidly; the Nexon is stocked as a fast-moving model at nearly all outlets.
spareParts.tip: Tata's genuine parts pricing is generally competitive with segment rivals; ask for the OEM catalogue number to avoid look-alike aftermarket parts.

faqs.q: Is the Nexon EV the same as the petrol/diesel Nexon page?
faqs.a: No — the Nexon EV has a separate variant line-up, battery warranty terms, and pricing, and is listed as its own model.

specs.safety: 5-star Global NCAP, dual airbags standard, 6 optional

reviews.author: Sandeep Rana
reviews.title: SUV stance in a car that parks like a hatchback
reviews.text: High seating position, tight turning radius and the 5-star safety rating make this ideal for first-time SUV buyers in a crowded city.

spareParts.authorizedServiceNote: Shares engine and several chassis parts with the Tiago/Tigor range, keeping common spares inexpensive and widely available.
spareParts.tip: Because the platform is shared with the Tiago/Tigor, several independent garages specialising in Tata hatchbacks can service the Punch at lower labour rates.

faqs.q: Is there a CNG version of the Punch?
faqs.a: Yes, Tata offers a factory-fitted iCNG option on select variants with dual-cylinder technology for retained boot space.

specs.safety: 5-star Global NCAP, 6 airbags, Level 2 ADAS (top trim)

reviews.author: Deepak Chawla
reviews.title: Effortless on hill roads, refined diesel
reviews.text: Regularly drive Dehradun-Mussoorie and the torque delivery makes hill climbs a non-event. Panoramic sunroof and JBL audio elevate the cabin experience.

spareParts.authorizedServiceNote: As a flagship SUV, parts are stocked mainly at larger Tata dealerships in metro and tier-1 cities; smaller towns may need 2-3 days for special order parts.
spareParts.tip: For long highway users, keep the diesel particulate filter service on schedule — regeneration cycles depend on sustained highway runs.

faqs.a: As of the current line-up the Harrier is diesel-only; Tata's petrol SUV offerings sit in the Nexon and upcoming Curvv range.
